__doc: No explorer knows these — they are protocol figures — so this file is the
simplest way to feed them: same-origin, no CORS, no infrastructure.
scripts/index-rewards.mjs rewrites this file on a schedule by summing
$CRCL transfers in and out of the rewards index contract on Base, so
edit it by hand only if that job is turned off.
Keys are plain numbers, not strings, and not pre-formatted:
totalFeesCollected   USD value of all fees routed to rewards
totalFees24hUsd      optional — fees taken in the last 24h, in USD
totalDistributedUsd  optional — omit and the site derives it from the
holders              optional — overrides the explorer lookup
holders24h           optional — net new holders over the last 24h
A field left null shows as an em dash on the site — or hides its 24h line
entirely — rather than a number that isn't real, so it is safe to publish
